title: 声と並びで、気持ちを伝える
prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create a content-rich portrait 9:16 English grammar page matching PAGE_0001. One continuous adventure-library stage with the same leopard showing calm statement, real question, and strong surprise. Original layout. No page number, source identity, logo or watermark.

Top title: 「声と並びで、気持ちを伝える」

Main progression:
• “You found the key.” 「伝える」— falling calm voice
• “Did you find the key?” 「たずねる」— did moves forward, questioning voice
• “What a lucky find!” 「驚く」— what brings the emotional target forward

Required comparison table:
「目的｜基本の形｜声の動き｜聞き手への働き」
「伝える｜主語＋動詞｜落ち着いて下がる｜情報を渡す」
「たずねる｜助動詞＋主語＋原形｜上がることが多い｜答えを求める」
「驚く｜What＋名詞 / How＋形容詞｜強く広がる｜感情を共有」

Add original contrast examples:
“Mia is here.” / “Is Mia here?” / “How wonderful!”
Short note: 「句読点だけでなく、語順・強勢・表情を一緒に使う。」
Mini check: Turn “Leo opened the door.” into a question. Answer: “Did Leo open the door?” Reason: 「didが過去を担当し、openは原形。」
Bottom ribbon: 「同じ内容でも、形と声で会話の役目が変わる」

Dense stage, sound arrows, table, examples, mini answer; large accurate typography.
